image_description: A close-up, high-resolution shot of the head and upper neck of a Nile crocodile resting on dry, earthy ground. The image focuses heavily on the texture of the skin, showing detailed osteoderms (bony scutes) and scales. The eye is visible with a vertical pupil, and the snout tapers towards the left. Teeth are partially visible along the jawline.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Head is broad and triangular with a V-shaped snout (narrower than alligator).
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The snout shape is clearly visible, tapering to a point consistent with a crocodilian V-shape rather than a U-shape.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Jaws are massive with numerous conical, interlocking teeth visible when mouth is closed.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The lower jaw teeth are visible protruding slightly or fitting into the upper jaw line, consistent with the closed-mouth anatomy described.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are positioned dorsally on the head with vertical slit pupils and a nictitating membrane.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The eye is clearly dorsal. The vertical slit pupil is distinct. The nictitating membrane is not clearly deployed (eye is open), but the structure is present.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Nostrils are positioned at the tip of the snout.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The very tip of the snout is cut off by the left edge of the frame; nostrils are not visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is elongated and heavily armored.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible portion of the neck and head shows heavy armor plating.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Body is covered in thick, bony scutes (osteoderms) arranged in regular longitudinal rows along the dorsal surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The large, raised, circular/oval scutes on the back of the neck/head are highly detailed and arranged in a structured pattern.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Scutes are dark brown to grey with a rough, heavily textured appearance.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Coloration is grey/brown with significant textural relief.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface is covered in smooth, rectangular scales that are pale yellow to white.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The underside (ventral surface) is not visible in this top-down/side-angle close-up.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Limbs are short and stout with webbed feet; forelimbs have five digits, hind limbs have four.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: No limbs are visible in the frame.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Tail is laterally compressed and muscular, comprising half of total body length.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The tail is not visible in the frame.
